name: E2E Networks Ltd
tagline: Listed AI/GPU cloud compute play with explosive Q1 FY27 growth (revenue +334% YoY, 75% EBITDA margin) - but promoter holding has fallen from ~60% to ~39%, the model is brutally capital-intensive, and the stock trades at ~400x earnings
business_overview: E2E Networks provides a full-stack AI/ML and GenAI cloud ecosystem — GPU compute clusters for training and inference — positioned as an Indian, listed, small-scale analog to global AI-cloud names like CoreWeave and Nebius. It operates ~5,100 GPUs (H100/H200/A100/V100 plus a live Blackwell B200 cluster) across third-party data centres in Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra and NCR (~10 MW aggregate). L&T holds a ~15%+ strategic stake taken via preferential allotment plus a secondary purchase from the promoter.
fundamentals_table: ~407x trailing (FY26 was a net loss; Q1 FY27 annualised P/E still ~70x+)
Rs 246 Cr (+50%) / Rs 126 Cr (51% margin) / net LOSS Rs 16 Cr (Rs 169 Cr depreciation from Rs 1,185 Cr GPU capex)
Revenue Rs 157 Cr (+334% YoY, +64% QoQ), EBITDA Rs 118 Cr (75.2% margin), PAT +Rs 44 Cr; exit MRR Rs 71.8 Cr/month (vs Rs 37.4 Cr in Mar 2026)
59.7% (Mar-24) -> 43.6% (Mar-25) -> 39.5% (Jun-26) - a ~20-point fall (secondary sale to L&T + serial equity dilution); no pledge (no-encumbrance declaration filed FY25-26)
Institutional debt facilities up to Rs 450 Cr drawn for GPU capex; prior raises: prefs Rs 405.66 Cr + Rs 1,079.28 Cr, QIP up to Rs 1,000 Cr (launched Feb 2026)
fundamentals_narrative: The demand story is real and the Q1 FY27 print is spectacular - revenue Rs 157 Cr (+334% YoY, +64% QoQ), a 75.2% EBITDA margin, PAT swinging to +Rs 44 Cr, and exit MRR nearly doubling in one quarter to Rs 71.8 Cr/month as the Blackwell B200 cluster went live at full utilisation. But the deep read surfaces three things the prior write-up understated. (1) The balance sheet is no longer 'almost debt-free': E2E has drawn on debt facilities of up to Rs 450 Cr for GPU capex and interest costs are rising. (2) FY26 was a reported net loss of Rs 16 Cr - Rs 1,185 Cr of GPU capex added Rs 169 Cr of annual depreciation, and GPUs obsolesce on a 3-4 year cycle, so this is a perpetual-capex, fast-depreciation model. (3) Promoter holding has fallen from 59.7% to 39.5% over three years - part secondary sale by Tarun Dua to L&T (~Rs 2,750/sh, Nov 2024), part heavy dilution across two large preferential issues and a Rs 1,000 Cr QIP. L&T's arrival as a ~15%+ strategic anchor is a governance positive, but the promoter is now a minority holder and The Ken published a critical article (17-Aug-2026) that the company formally refuted as 'factually incorrect'. At ~407x trailing earnings and ~Rs 12,890 Cr market cap the stock prices in years of flawless hyper-growth.

bull_case: Genuinely exceptional demand ramp: Q1 FY27 revenue +334% YoY / +64% QoQ, 75.2% EBITDA margin, PAT turned positive, exit MRR nearly doubled in a single quarter to Rs 71.8 Cr/month
Direct listed proxy for the Indian AI-compute buildout; Blackwell B200 cluster live at full utilisation with more Blackwell capacity arriving
L&T (a ~Rs 4 lakh crore blue-chip) is a ~15%+ strategic shareholder via preferential allotment plus a board relationship - a meaningful governance and balance-sheet anchor
Large, well-funded war chest for capex: two preferential issues (Rs 405.66 Cr + Rs 1,079.28 Cr) fully/near-fully deployed plus a Rs 1,000 Cr QIP
Sovereign-cloud / India AI Mission order exposure provides a demand leg less tied to the private AI-capex cycle
bear_case: Promoter holding has collapsed from 59.7% to 39.5% in three years (secondary sale to L&T + serial dilution) - the promoter is now a minority holder; HIGH CAUTION
The Ken published a critical article (17-Aug-2026) which the company formally refuted as 'factually incorrect' - an unresolved governance/disclosure question from a credible outlet
Brutally capital-intensive model: Rs 1,185 Cr GPU capex in FY26 drove a Rs 169 Cr depreciation charge and a full-year net LOSS of Rs 16 Cr; GPUs obsolesce on a 3-4 year cycle so capex never stops
No longer 'almost debt-free' - up to Rs 450 Cr of institutional debt drawn for capex, interest costs rising, and further equity dilution is ongoing (Rs 1,000 Cr QIP)
~407x trailing P/E at ~Rs 12,890 Cr market cap - even on an annualised Q1 FY27 run-rate the multiple is ~70x+, pricing in years of uninterrupted hyper-growth
Competitive exposure to global hyperscalers on price; GPU supply/demand and pricing explicitly flagged as risks by management
verdict_headline: Spectacular Q1 FY27 growth, but a promoter-holding collapse to ~39%, a refuted critical press article, a perpetual-capex model and ~400x earnings pull conviction down hard
verdict_reasoning: The demand and margin inflection is real and large (Q1 FY27 revenue +334% YoY, 75% EBITDA margin, PAT positive, exit MRR Rs 71.8 Cr/month) - the growth thesis is not in question

But promoter holding has fallen ~20 points to 39.5% (part secondary sale, part dilution) - a HIGH CAUTION governance marker - compounded by The Ken's refuted-but-unresolved article and a business model that consumes capital continuously and reported a FY26 net loss
Valuation (~407x trailing, ~70x+ on an annualised run-rate) leaves no margin of safety
Conviction cut High -> Low-Medium under the HIGH CAUTION rule; thesis-fit stays 10x-in-2-3-years on the strength of the growth ramp, but this is a high-variance, governance-caveated bet
red_flag_reason: Promoter holding fell from 59.7% (Mar-2024) to 39.5% (Jun-2026) - part secondary sale by the promoter to L&T, part serial equity dilution - leaving the promoter a minority holder. Compounded by a critical 17-Aug-2026 article in The Ken that the company refuted as factually incorrect. No pledge (no-encumbrance declaration filed FY25-26), and L&T's ~15%+ strategic stake is a partial offset, but the magnitude of the holding decline triggers HIGH CAUTION.
